scope: SLP Chapter 3 (Mathematical Preliminaries): metric and normed vector spaces with the examples of Ex 3.2-3.5; completeness, Theorem 3.1 and the classification of Ex 3.6; spaces of continuously differentiable functions (Ex 3.7, with the converse of Ex 3.7c refuted); the Contraction Mapping Theorem 3.2, Corollaries 1-2 and Ex 3.8-3.9; a differential equation by Picard iteration (Ex 3.10); Blackwell's sufficient conditions (Theorem 3.3) and the growth model's operator; successive approximations and Ex 3.1; lower and upper hemi-continuity, Ex 3.11-3.15 and Theorems 3.4-3.5; the Theorem of the Maximum (Theorem 3.6), Lemma 3.7, Theorem 3.8 and the examples of Ex 3.16.
source: Stokey, Lucas and Prescott (1989), Recursive Methods in Economic Dynamics, Chapter 3.
